Road conditions

  • (302)760-2080 Live during business hours-no recording available (Conditions)
  • http://www.deldot.gov/public.ejs?command=PublicLocatableMap (Advisory/Restrictions/Weather)

Permit Limitations

  • Weight: Single-20,000; Tandem-34,000; 2 axles-40,000; 3 axles-54,000; 4 axles -74,000; 5 axles-80,000 or the bridge formula
  • Length: 53’
  • Width: 102”
  • Height: 13’6”
  • Restrictions and modifications will be noted on the permit.

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

One (1) escort

  • More than twelve (12) feet in width/not exceeding fourteen (14) feet.
  • Eighty-five (85) feet or more overall length

Two (2) escorts

  • More than fourteen (14) feet in width
  • One hundred (100) feet or more in overall length
  • Fifteen (15) feet or more in height
  • More than 120,000 lbs. Weight

Separate state police escort (third escort)

  • More than fifteen (15) feet in width
  • One hundred twenty(120) or more in length
  • Seventeen feet six inches (17’6”) or more in height
  • More than 120,000 lbs. Weight
  • https://deldot.gov/CLF4Apps/osow/pdfs/policy.pdf
  • Delaware State Police (DSP) Escort(s)

Travel Times

  • Permitted vehicles may move Monday through Friday, from sunrise to sunset, unless otherwise authorized or prohibited by the permit. Prohibited holidays include New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, the day after Thanksgiving, and Christmas.

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • Vehicle no smaller than a compact car
  • Signs: On roof (“OVERSIZE LOAD” on both sides)or front & rear (“OVERSIZE LOAD” on one side); Minimum 5’ x 12”; black letters 8” high on yellow background
  • Lights: Not required in DE but may be located on roof & be 43”-52” long/10”-13” wide/4”-8” high consisting of flashing or strobe lights (min. 4 lights-2 at each end)
  • Flags: Red or orange fluorescent; 18” square
  • Additional equipment: 2-way radio

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • Not Applicable
